learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the days of the week, the months of the year, and how time flies by!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: There are 7 days in a week. We start school on Monday and have a super fun holiday on Sunday!
A full year has 12 long months. Your happy birthday comes in one of these special months every single year!
We wake up in the morning, play games in the evening, and go to sweet sleep at night when the shiny stars come out.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Favorite Calendar
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents for an old calendar. Take a bright red crayon and draw a circle around your birthday and your friends' birthdays!

quick_recap: ⭐ There are 7 days in a week and 12 months in a year.
⭐ We use a calendar to find out what day and date it is.
⭐ The day is divided into morning, afternoon, evening, and night.
